title: Midnight Library
lyrics:
When the midnight library lights begin to glow
I count the paper planets in a quiet row
Turn another page and let the city sleep
All the little promises are ours to keep

title: Copper Kettle Morning
lyrics:
Copper kettle calling on a rainy morning train
Steam across the window writes a silver name
Carry all the daylight in a worn out case
Find me by the river at the old familiar place

title: Paper Rocket Parade
lyrics:
Fold a paper rocket for the afternoon sky
Write a tiny map where the cloudy rooftops lie
Every little engine hums a hopeful tune
We will reach the kitchen moon before too soon
